Where's the best place to honeymoon?

Gran Canaria is really nice, I was there on my last holiday. Hawaii is really beautiful too. It depends on what you are looking for? Typical coasting at the beach, adventures in the deep jungle or exploring countries you'd usually not travel to (India for example).
Just trying to see what people think and maybe open our options up to something we may not have considered before.

Certainly a good idea. But in the end it depends on what you as a couple want. The typical honeymoon by the beach will be nice and relaxing but it will be "just another vacation" if you understand what I mean. Going on an expedition to Africa or into the jungle, the poorer countries of the world, may be more stressing and maybe won't leave so much time for ähem other activities but it will be more memorable.
I haven't traveled very much so I'm overwhelmed because we can go anywhere lol
Well then go somewhere where you know you won't return for a long time. If you are marrying I'm sure at some point children will be in the picture. The exotic locations aren't an option anymore then.
Depends on how much money you want to spend. What's the budget?
Somewhere around 10,000 which is what we would have spent on a big wedding.

With that kind of budget you can do pretty much anything you wish. It really will depend on what you enjoy doing.

If you're a nature person, I'd go to Hawaii or maybe New Zealand/Austrailia for the amazing landscapes.

If you're into architecture, art and history, go to Rome and the surrounding European countryside.

Maybe you're into activities? Scuba diving etc, hit up the Bahamas or similar.

One thing I will say is that you may or may not ever get to experience the place you go on your honeymoon again. Pick a place on your bucket list because that's truly what it's all about. Experiencing your life with your partner in an exotic place.

Hawaii is at the top of my list, preferably not in Honolulu/Waikiki (though I'm sure that's high on someone's list).

Another option that seems like it might be fun would be a cruise with a lot of sea days (like a trans-Atlantic). Though I'd think it would be wise to have cruise experience before planning that for a honeymoon.
